references.text: The angel prophesied that Ishmael would live over against all his brothers – fulfilled in 25:18 with the expression "he settled over against all his brothers".
The list of Ishmael's twelve sons and their settlements, which forms the immediate context for the geographical description in verse 18.
Ishmael grew up in the wilderness of Paran and took an Egyptian wife, providing background for where his descendants settled.
Uses the same geographical expression "from Havilah to Shur" as in Genesis 25:18, describing the same area.
The first mention of Havilah in the Bible, relevant to the geographical reference in 25:18.
Mentions the wilderness of Shur (the way to Shur), which is the western boundary for the settlement of Ishmael's descendants in 25:18.
